articles.description: A U.S. Air Force F-35A Lightning II aircraft assigned to the 35th Fighter Wing taxis alongside a Japan Air Self-Defense Force F-35A Lightning II aircraft assigned to the 3rd Air Wing during Exercise Keen Sword 27 at Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hachinohe Air Base, Japan, on Oct. 20, 2026. articles.title: India-Singapore naval exercise SIMBEX-2026 concludes in Visakhapatnam
SIMBEX-2026: 33rd India-Singapore naval exercise concludes
articles.description: The 33rd Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise concluded in Visakhapatnam on October 26, with INS Nilgiri and RSS Supreme taking part in harbour and sea phases.
